name: Minor Hotels
h1: New markets, long runways, one development tracker
lede: Minor Hotels is growing asset-right through management agreements and franchises in Australia, India, the United States and Vietnam. Airtable connects the owners, pre-opening timelines and brand standards behind every signing.
why_h2: A signing pipeline across four new frontiers
why_p: Each new agreement starts years of pre-opening work shared between owners, design, operations and brand teams.

signals.title: Anantara Perth signed
signals.body: A 150-key Anantara hotel will anchor the AUD 3.8 billion Burswood Point development, opening in 2032, adding to a 60-plus property Oaks and Avani portfolio in Australia.
signals.angle: Hold a decade-long pre-opening timeline in one shared view across owners, design and brand standards.

signals.title: First Anantara properties in India
signals.body: Minor signed Anantara Zanti Coorg for 2028 and Anantara Kolkata for 2032, with a target of 50 properties in India within the decade.
signals.angle: Repeatable development trackers per market make the next fifty signings faster to run.
signals.src: Minor Hotels newsroom via Hotel Online, 8 Apr 2026

signals.title: Anantara's first US property
signals.body: Anantara Miami Resort and Residences was announced as the brand's first property in the United States.
signals.angle: Coordinate residences, resort and brand workstreams for a market entry in one place.

signals.title: Avani+ Hanoi signed
signals.body: A 310-key Avani+ in the Hinode City precinct was signed under a management agreement, opening in 2028.
signals.angle: Give owner KPIs and pre-opening budgets one system of record from signing to opening.
